references.text: The description of the original menorah that God commanded Moses to make, which provides context for the instructions on lighting the lamps in Numbers 8.
Earlier instructions about keeping the lamps burning in the tabernacle, which Numbers 8 expands upon.
Parallel instructions regarding the lamps and the menorah in the sanctuary, given to Moses by the Lord.
Moses placed the menorah in the tent of meeting and lit the lamps before the face of the Lord, as prescribed.
A similar introductory formula where the Lord speaks to Moses, typical of Numbers.
